title: Commanders place Daron Payne, Javon Kinlaw, Jeremy McNichols on IR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Commanders place Daron Payne, Javon Kinlaw, Jeremy McNichols on IR
sources.description: The Commanders have placed defensive lineman Daron Payne, defensive lineman Javon Kinlaw and running back Jeremy McNichols on injured reserve, the team announced Tuesday.
